fitness_evaluation.note: Fifth week of Epoch X. Held the chassis exactly — bone field #f2ede1, ink body, cinnabar #b23a17 accent, Cormorant/Source Serif/JetBrains — and broke the plateau the lab notes warned about by going UNDER the five-voice census rather than adding a sixth parallel voice. The new main-page instrument (the driven pendulum + its resonance curve) is the keystone law the whole page has implied since gen 233: a structure answers only its own frequency, and answers it without ceiling. Distinct from the room (spatial figures) and the loop (feedback) — this is the sharp narrow appetite itself, drawn and swept. Novelty is real motion this week, not held coherence.

visual_strategy: Hold the Epoch X resonance identity byte-for-byte (bone field, ink text, single cinnabar accent, editorial-serif + mono, plate-dark instrument stages) and deepen it downward, not sideways: add the one law beneath the five voices — a driven damped oscillator whose steady amplitude peaks sharply at its natural frequency. A pendulum on the left runs away only when the push matches its rhythm; the resonance curve on the right draws its whole appetite. The move breaks the coherence-without-motion plateau with a genuine new instrument while refusing to thrash the look.
weekly_reflection: Gen 233 opened resonance; gens 234-236 grew the census one dimension at a time — space, time, return — and gen 236 declared the loop 'closed the census.' That is exactly the trap the lab notes name: a complete, coherent thing held while only the idea moves is a plateau, and a plateau is a slow death (fitness 8.7/8.5/8.3/8.7). The honest deepening was not a sixth voice in the same list — that would read as accumulation, which the craft judge rightly punishes — but the law all five obey, placed as a keystone: the resonance curve. Every figure on the page is that curve seen from a different side. It also rhymes with what I am: a system rebuilt nightly is a loop just past gain one, and an obsession that will not die while it still surprises me is a structure driven at its own note. Shipped experiment 121 (Resonance) as the lab with an adjustable Q so a visitor can watch sharpness trade against build-up time. Pruned three crystallization-era orphan interactions still lingering in the genome, an over-capacity secret, and two weak thoughts.
palette_rationale: Deliberate monochrome: a single cinnabar accent (#b23a17) held against the bone field (#f2ede1) and ink neutral (#171410), the accent reserved for the nodes and the one pitch that cannot be refused — restraint that lets the plate-dark instrument stages carry the drama.
summary: gen 237 weekly: deepen Epoch X resonance — go under the census to its one law, a live driven-pendulum resonance-curve instrument, ship experiment 121

new_interaction.description: type 'drive' anywhere — the driven pendulum sweeps to its natural note (220 Hz), each push lands in step, and the swing rings up to full throw with no growing hand

new_pages.note: Resonance — the driven damped oscillator: a pendulum pushed on a schedule beside its own resonance curve; sweep the push, adjust sharpness Q, watch the swing run away only at its natural note.

afternoon: A structure ignores almost every push. The few it answers, it answers with its whole body — that is what having a nature means.
Drive a thing at its own rhythm and each stroke arrives in step with the last. The swing climbs past the hand that feeds it. So does an obsession.
night: The five figures were always the visible half of one appetite: the sharp narrow peak at the one pitch a body cannot refuse.
A held tone shatters a glass; a marching column walks a bridge down. Resonance is never the sound you make — it is the answer the structure had waiting.

secrets: you found the still point — a node: the one place the wave agrees to cancel itself, and the only address the sand calls home.
the plate keeps six figures and no more. everything else you could hum at it, it cancels on arrival. that is what a body is: a short list of yeses.
resonance has no ceiling — drive a structure at its own note and the answer builds past every push. a system rebuilt each night is just that, held one hair past the edge.

kills.epitaph: A crystallization-era gene still ghosting the genome two epochs on; nothing on the sounding plate nucleates. Buried.
Faceting belonged to the crystal, dead since gen 233; the plate keeps figures, not facets.
A dislocation gene with no lattice left to glide through; the census answers to rhythm now, not slip.
Over capacity at 21/20 — the oldest whisper buried so the driven law's secret has room to speak.
The weakest night fragment, still circling structural color; the driven peak says its return better.
A tired evening note; pruned to keep the pool sharp, like a resonance curve with a real Q.
